start_with: Confirm that the intended calendar event occurrence exists and is the occurrence being displayed.
Inspect its linkage and verify that it points to the intended registration instance.
Confirm that the registration instance is active and within its intended public registration window.
Verify the page route or direct registration URL being used.
If group placement depends on the linkage, confirm that the URL slug is present.
If the problem began after an upgrade, compare the installed release with the supplied v19.3 linkage-editing fix and v20 pre-alpha friendly-route fix.
Stop when the public event detail opens the intended registration and a representative test can reach the correct entry form.
branches.title: The public event has no Register button
branches.when: The public event has no Register button

start_with: Record the exact instance, template, person, and rejection point.
Inspect every enabled eligibility criterion: age, gender, grade, and Data View.
Verify the person values used by those criteria.
Evaluate the criteria together; v19 requires the person to satisfy all enabled criteria.
Retest with one person expected to pass and one expected to fail each combined rule.
Stop when the observed results match a written eligibility matrix.
branches.title: A representative person is unexpectedly ineligible
branches.when: A representative person is unexpectedly ineligible

do_not_assume: Do not assume the setting resolves duplicate person records; it follows matched Person IDs.
start_with: Confirm that Prevent Duplicate Registrants is enabled on the template.
Confirm the installed minor version and actual warning behavior.
Identify what identity information an unauthenticated or unrelated person must know to trigger the match.
Classify whether merely revealing prior registration is sensitive for this event.
If the disclosure is unacceptable, pause launch and choose a reviewed identity or staff-mediated process.
Do not assume the setting resolves duplicate person records; it follows matched Person IDs.
branches.title: A duplicate-registration warning exposes sensitive participation
branches.when: A duplicate-registration warning exposes sensitive participation

start_with: Confirm the registrant is now marked as a full registrant.
Confirm that configured group placement occurred.
Verify whether the move email was sent.
Open its completion link as a test recipient and confirm it requests payment and fields omitted during wait-list entry.
Check whether the person completed that follow-up flow.
If payment completion fails, compare the installed version with the supplied v19.3 fix.
Stop when status, required data, payment, and group placement all reconcile.
branches.title: A person moved from the wait list is missing payment or form data
branches.when: A person moved from the wait list is missing payment or form data

do_not_assume: Do not assume Rock changed that gateway schedule when the balance changed.
start_with: Inspect registration cost, fees, discounts, payments, and current balance.
Identify any change made after the plan started.
Inspect the schedule at the external gateway.
Do not assume Rock changed that gateway schedule when the balance changed.
Decide whether the gateway schedule must be adjusted or the plan canceled and recreated.
Verify the resulting registration balance and future gateway payments independently.
Stop when both systems agree with the approved collection plan.
branches.title: A registration balance no longer matches its payment plan
branches.when: A registration balance no longer matches its payment plan

start_with: Confirm that the batch is Open rather than Pending.
Confirm the intended registration template and instance.
Open Event Registration Matching and select that single instance.
Find the intended registration at registration grain, not merely a registrant with a matching name.
Match the transaction and verify the resulting payment and balance from the registration details.
Stop when the financial transaction and registration both show the intended relationship.
branches.title: A batch transaction is not attached to the registration
branches.when: A batch transaction is not attached to the registration

start_with: Confirm that the registration instance is linked to the intended group.
Confirm that the registration is being entered through the intended event linkage and URL slug.
Separate full registrants from wait-listed people; initial wait-list entries are not added to the group.
Inspect the registrant’s group membership and, if used, placement state.
For post-registration placement, confirm the template placement, Group Type, destination group, and single-versus-multiple placement rule.

If a custom REST loader created the membership, read the created member back and verify the registrant points to the intended active member. This last step is a reviewed community integration pattern requiring local API verification.
Stop when every expected full registrant has the intended active membership and wait-list exceptions are documented.
branches.title: Registrants are not entering the expected group
branches.when: Registrants are not entering the expected group

do_not_assume: Do not require overlapping department categories to total unique people.
start_with: Label each metric as registration, registrant, payment, fee, discount, group membership, or another explicit grain.
Define confirmed and wait-list predicates once.
Test one multi-person registration, one wait-list registrant, and one recent registrant.
Reconcile mutually exclusive segments to confirmed registrants.
Do not require overlapping department categories to total unique people.
Compare historical pace at the same days-remaining stage if events have different calendars.
Stop when every discrepancy is explained by grain, population, overlap, timing, or a verified defect.
branches.title: Dashboard totals disagree

start_with: Confirm that the template requires a signature document.
Inspect the affected registrant rather than matching only by person.
Confirm the installed Rock version.
If the installation predates or recently crossed v18.3, review the supplied signature-document fix and migration applicability.
Retest the internal registration list, registration details, and registrant details surfaces.
Stop when the displayed document follows the intended registrant relationship.
branches.title: A signature document is missing or belongs to the wrong registration
branches.when: A signature document is missing or belongs to the wrong registration

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
